messages:
maria_ae: Quick heads-up — FinServCo POC requires a detailed regional data-path map + sub-processor inventory for the CISO review next Thursday. They want confirmation on: EU-only data residency for PII, KMS BYOK options, and routing failover behavior. Who can pull a clean diagram + call out pricing impact?

sam_se: Do they allow any cross-border failover for high-availability (e.g., eu->us) or is hard EU-only? :thinking_face: CISO deadline noted.

bob_finserv: Hi — CISO: PII must remain in EU. Non-PII metrics/logs can be exported but must be pseudonymized. Failover is allowed only to other EU regions; no US egress for PII.

olivia_solutions: OK — I can create a data-path diagram and a short subproc table. Quick Q: KMS — do they require customer-managed keys (BYOK) in their tenant, or is Redwood-managed EU KMS acceptable?

bob_finserv: BYOK required, must be in Azure Key Vault (EU).

ken_legal: Noted. I'll check the DPA/subprocessor clauses and whether we need any amended SCARs for Azure BYOK. Ping me on anything with contract language.

ira_engineer: Implementation note: For strict EU-only PII we should propose either Dedicated EU pools (reserved) or Private deployment (VPC) into the customer's VNet. Hosted multi-tenant can be constrained but has fallback risk. Dedicated/Private -> predictable routing keep-in-region.

sam_se: Ballpark cost impacts: Dedicated EU-only reserved capacity ~+25-35% vs global shared hosted on same commit. BYOK integration + one-time eng effort (~40h) + +$X/mo for key proxying. Will get exact numbers.

olivia_solutions: Draft routing policy snippet for POC (will include in diagram):
```
routing_policy:
  prefer_region: [europe-west1, europe-west3, northeurope]
  allowed_e2e_regions_for_pii: [europe-west1, europe-west3, northeurope]
  fallback_behavior: reject_for_pii, allow_readonly_for_metrics
  subprocessor_whitelist: [Azure (eu-north, northeurope), GCP (europe-west1), AWS (eu-west-1)]
  kms_mode: customer_managed_azure_byoK
```
(note: whitelist only used for visibility; contractual subprocessor list must come from Legal)

maria_ae: Action items: 1) Olivia -> deliver diagram + subproc table by Wed EOD (owner: olivia_solutions). 2) Sam -> formal pricing delta + one-time BYOK estimate by Fri (owner: sam_se). 3) Ken -> confirm DPA/SCAR implications and any contract addenda by Tue (owner: ken_legal). 4) Ira -> confirm whether Dedicated vs Private is required for ops/runbook and estimate infra lead time (owner: ira_engineer). I'll consolidate into the POC brief.

sam_se: I'll also add a short note about SLOs: latency/throughput targets might change if we pin to single region; will surface perf delta.

redwood_bot: Ticket #POC-773 created for FinServCo EU residency POC. Assigned: olivia_solutions, sam_se, ken_legal, ira_engineer. ETA: 2024-06-14.

bob_finserv: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please cc me when diagram is ready.

maria_ae: Thanks — adding links to POC repo and CISO questionnaire in the ticket now.

sam_se: I'll ping infra to reserve tentative capacity in eu-west1 for the window. :white_check_mark:

olivia_solutions: Will post the first diagram draft to the thread when ready. :eyes:
